answer:
I added a "Weather in Porto now" card to the App side of your Porto weekend note. It shows the temperature, conditions, what it feels like, wind and humidity. I haven't seen it show real data, because the check ran on a sample note and not your live weather.

The card pulls live data from Open-Meteo, which needs no API key. Amber Notes will ask you to approve that site (api.open-meteo.com) the first time you open the App side. If the data can't load, the card says so.

I didn't change the note's text. The app only shows the weather each time you open it. It doesn't save it into the note.
